title: Website repo: local CI and deploy scripts (GitHub Actions unusable for the private repo)
description: Chattic.us-web is private, so GitHub Actions is over quota and every job fails to start (billing), as of 2026-10-13. Ryan's rule: run CI ourselves, locally, and deploy locally. Add to the website repo (AnthusAI/Chattic.us-web, PR for review): (1) scripts/ci-local.sh replicating .github/workflows/ci.yml on the current checkout: a python venv with pyyaml and limatus, the three editorial scripts under .claude/skills/publication-writing/scripts, npm install, pip install -e node_modules/chatticus/python[wiki] behave, npm run build, typecheck, npm test, behave, and in infra/: npm install, npm test, cdk synth with a placeholder out/; non-zero exit on any failure; (2) scripts/deploy-local.sh for production: refuse unless the working tree is clean main, run the CI script, build, then run cdk diff of ChatticusMarketing with CHATTICUS_MARKETING_INCLUDE_APEX=1 and the legacy AWS profile credentials, refuse if the diff contains anything other than the DeployWebsite source zip change (in particular any apex alias or Route53 apex record removal: the flag omission would take chattic.us offline), then deploy, then run check_live_copy.py; (3) README section documenting both, and a note in the workflows that they are manual/legacy while Actions is unavailable. Acceptance: running scripts/ci-local.sh on main passes (76 behave scenarios, 34 tests, infra tests, synth); deploy-local.sh in a dry-run mode prints the diff verdict without deploying. See memory note website-ci-and-deploy and the near-miss on 2026-10-13.
right_now_summary: Local CI and deployment scripts are being added to replace unavailable GitHub Actions and protect production.
